Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.CausalCheckpoint → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.CausalCheckpoint → Prop := fun before after => after.historyDomain = before.historyDomain ∧ after.document = before.document ∧ after.sequence = before.sequence + 1

{capacity : ℕ} → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.CausalCheckpoint → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.CausalCheckpoint → Fin capacity → Option Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.SourceEntry → Option Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.SourceEntry → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Delta capacity

{motive : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.RejectReason → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.RejectReason) → t.ctorIdx = 2 → motive Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.RejectReason.nonCausal → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.RejectReason → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.RejectReason) → t.ctorIdx = 0 → motive Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.RejectReason.staleCheckpoint → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.RejectReason → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.RejectReason) → t.ctorIdx = 1 → motive Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.RejectReason.staleRow → motive t

{capacity : ℕ} → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Snapshot capacity → Prop := fun {capacity} snapshot => snapshot.indexCheckpoint = snapshot.sourceCheckpoint ∧ snapshot.cursor.checkpoint = snapshot.sourceCheckpoint ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.SyncCursor.Complete capacity snapshot.cursor ∧ snapshot.index = Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.rebuild snapshot.corpus

{capacity : ℕ} → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Snapshot capacity → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Delta capacity → Prop := fun {capacity} snapshot delta => snapshot.sourceCheckpoint = delta.beforeCheckpoint ∧ snapshot.corpus delta.slot = delta.before ∧ delta.beforeCheckpoint.Follows delta.afterCheckpoint

{motive : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Status → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Status) → t.ctorIdx = 0 → motive Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Status.current → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Status → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Status) → t.ctorIdx = 3 → motive Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Status.incompleteCursor → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Status → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Status) → t.ctorIdx = 1 → motive Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Status.staleCheckpoint → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Status → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Status) → t.ctorIdx = 2 → motive Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Status.staleCursor → motive t

{motive : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Status → Sort u} → (t : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Status) → t.ctorIdx = 4 → motive Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Status.staleRows → motive t
ℕ → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.SyncCursor → Prop := fun capacity cursor => cursor.nextSlot = capacity
ℕ → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.SyncCursor → Prop := fun capacity cursor => cursor.nextSlot ≤ capacity

∀ {capacity : ℕ} (snapshot : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Snapshot capacity) (delta : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Delta capacity), snapshot.MatchesDelta delta → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.applyDelta snapshot delta = Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.ApplyResult.applied (snapshot.advance delta)

∀ {capacity : ℕ} (snapshot : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Snapshot capacity) (delta : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Delta capacity), delta.beforeCheckpoint.Follows delta.afterCheckpoint → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.applyDelta (snapshot.advance delta) delta = Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.ApplyResult.replayed (snapshot.advance delta)
{capacity : ℕ} → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Index capacity → Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.LinkTarget → Fin capacity → Option Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.IndexedRow

∀ {capacity : ℕ} (snapshot : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Snapshot capacity), snapshot.Fresh → ∀ (slot : Fin capacity) (entry : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.SourceEntry), snapshot.corpus slot = Option.some entry → entry.record.tombstonedAt = Option.none → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.backlinkAt snapshot.index entry.record.target slot = Option.some { linkId := entry.linkId, sourceDocument := entry.record.sourceDocument, sourceRange := entry.record.source, target := entry.record.target, relation := entry.record.relation, operation := entry.record.operation }

∀ {capacity : ℕ} (index : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Index capacity) (target : Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.LinkTarget) (slot : Fin capacity) (row : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.IndexedRow), Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.backlinkAt index target slot = Option.some row → index slot = Option.some row ∧ row.target = target

∀ {capacity : ℕ} (corpus : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Corpus capacity) (slot : Fin capacity) (entry : Option Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.SourceEntry), Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.rebuild (Function.update corpus slot entry) = Function.update (Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.rebuild corpus) slot (entry.bind Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.SourceEntry.row?)

{capacity : ℕ} → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Index capacity → Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.DocumentId → Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.StableRange → Fin capacity → Option Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.IndexedRow

∀ {capacity : ℕ} (snapshot : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Snapshot capacity), snapshot.Fresh → ∀ (slot : Fin capacity) (entry : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.SourceEntry) (range : Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.StableRange), snapshot.corpus slot = Option.some entry → entry.record.tombstonedAt = Option.none → entry.record.source = Option.some range → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.stableRangeAt snapshot.index entry.record.sourceDocument range slot = Option.some { linkId := entry.linkId, sourceDocument := entry.record.sourceDocument, sourceRange := entry.record.source, target := entry.record.target, relation := entry.record.relation, operation := entry.record.operation }

∀ {capacity : ℕ} (index : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Index capacity) (document : Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.DocumentId) (range : Minidregg.Theory.Hyperdocument.StableRange) (slot : Fin capacity) (row : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.IndexedRow), Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.stableRangeAt index document range slot = Option.some row → index slot = Option.some row ∧ row.sourceDocument = document ∧ row.sourceRange = Option.some range

∀ {capacity : ℕ} (device : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Device capacity) (delta : Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.Delta capacity), delta.beforeCheckpoint.Follows delta.afterCheckpoint → Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.applyDelta (device.stage (device.durable.advance delta)).sync.crash.reopen delta = Minidregg.Kernel.HyperdocumentIndexSync.ApplyResult.replayed (device.durable.advance delta)
